shots.scene: 欣欣站在一只固定好的气瓶旁，手拿放大镜，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a strapped gas cylinder holding a magnifying glass and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课教你读懂气瓶上的标记。

shots.scene: 瓶颈、标签、钢印、色环四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cylinder neck ring, a blank product label, stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder, and a colored band around a cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 钢印、标签、颜色，都在说话。

shots.scene: 供气单位刚送来气瓶，阿杰签收时只看了一眼颜色
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs for a newly delivered gas cylinder, glancing only at its color.
shots.narration: 新气瓶送到，阿杰看了眼颜色就签收。

shots.scene: 小研指着瓶肩钢印，阿杰一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the stamped marks on the cylinder shoulder; the young male student looks confused.
shots.narration: 小研问：它什么时候检验到期？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark icon above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰答不上来。我们一起来学。

shots.section_title: 会读标记是用气基本功
shots.scene: 小研用手指着瓶肩钢印，欣欣在旁点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student traces the stamped marks on the cylinder shoulder with a gloved finger while the panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 找到检验日期、看懂标记，是基本功。
overlay: 会读标记是用气基本功

shots.scene: 瓶肩钢印特写，旁边浮现五个空白小卡片
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder with five small blank cards floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶肩上的钢印，记着气瓶的身世。

shots.section_title: 瓶颈处的产权或制造单位
shots.scene: 瓶颈圈上的刻字特写，手指示意（刻字模糊不可读）
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at blurred engraved letters on the neck ring of a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶颈处刻着产权单位或制造单位。
overlay: 瓶颈处的产权或制造单位

shots.scene: 气瓶肩部贴着空白标签，上面只有危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder shoulder with a blank product label showing only a hazard pictogram diamond. No people.
shots.narration: 每只气瓶都要有清楚的标签。

shots.scene: 标签图标旁浮现气体名、危害两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon with two blank cards floating beside it: one with a gas cylinder icon, one with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 标签写明装的什么气、有什么危害。

shots.scene: 两只颜色相同的气瓶，问号在中间
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinders painted the same color side by side, with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 只看颜色认气体，靠不住。

shots.section_title: 读标签，查安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研对照瓶身标签，翻阅空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares the cylinder label with a blank safety data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 要读标签，再查安全技术说明书。
overlay: 读标签，查安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 读标签，查安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 易燃、助燃、有毒、窒息、高压五个象形图图标
shots.prompt_en: Five hazard pictogram icons in a row: a flame, a flame over a circle, a skull, a person short of breath, and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 弄清它的危害和性质。

shots.scene: 一排各种颜色的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A row of gas cylinders of many different colors, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 进口气瓶和不同来源，配色可能不同。

shots.scene: 没有标签的气瓶被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder with no label at all, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标签掉了、看不清，坚决不用。

shots.scene: 小研打电话联系供应单位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student phones the gas supplier while standing beside an unlabeled cylinder.
shots.narration: 立即联系供应单位处理。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检
shots.scene: 老李用推车送来气瓶，老周签收
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer delivers a cylinder on a hand truck; the older man signs a blank receipt.
shots.narration: 实验室气瓶多是向供气单位租用。
overlay: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检

shots.section_title: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检
shots.scene: 供气单位的仓库图标，箭头指向检验设备图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas supplier warehouse with an arrow to an icon of a cylinder testing station. No people.
shots.narration: 定期检验，由产权单位负责送检。

shots.scene: 气瓶处在运输、充装、使用三个场景图标的中心
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder in the center surrounded by three icons: a delivery truck, a filling station and a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶必须定期检验，

shots.scene: 三个场景图标上方出现绿色盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Green shield icons appear above the truck, filling station and lab bench icons. No people.
shots.narration: 运输、充装、使用的人才安全。

shots.scene: 瓶肩上的检验标记旁浮现日历图标
shots.prompt_en: Inspection marks on a cylinder shoulder with a calendar icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 检验标记告诉你多久检一次。

shots.scene: 日历翻到到期月，气瓶被推回供气单位
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flips to a circled month, and a cylinder on a cart rolls back toward a supplier warehouse icon. No people.
shots.narration: 快到期了，按时退回送检。

shots.section_title: 只有一个日期：制造和首检
shots.scene: 钢印中只有一行日期被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder shoulder with only one stamped date line, circled in yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 只有一个日期？那是制造年月。
overlay: 只有一个日期：制造和首检

shots.section_title: 只有一个日期：制造和首检
shots.scene: 新出厂气瓶图标旁打一个绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a brand-new cylinder leaving a factory with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 也就是它出厂和第一次检验的时间。

shots.section_title: 检验周期因瓶因气而异
shots.scene: 几种不同气瓶与不同气体图标，下面各配一个日历
shots.prompt_en: Several different cylinder types with different gas icons, each above its own calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 检验周期，因气瓶种类和气体而异。
overlay: 检验周期因瓶因气而异

shots.section_title: 检验周期因瓶因气而异
shots.scene: 王老师指着空白的规程手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank regulations binder.
shots.narration: 具体周期，按气瓶安全技术规程。

shots.scene: 瓶肩钢印下方多行日期依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Several stamped date lines on a cylinder shoulder light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 看到好几个日期？那是历次检验。

shots.scene: 检验标记示意：日期和检验单位两个空白格
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an inspection mark with two blank boxes, one with a calendar icon and one with a building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 标记里有检验年月和检验单位。

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 小研手指停在最下方、最新的一行
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student's gloved finger stops on the newest date line at the bottom.
shots.narration: 找到最近一次检验日期，
overlay: 找到最近一次，算出下一次

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 日历加号周期图标，等于下次检验
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon plus a cycle arrow icon equals a calendar with a circled future month. No people.
shots.narration: 加上规定周期，就是下次检验时间。

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 过期日历被红叉划掉，气瓶旁有停止手势
shots.prompt_en: An expired calendar crossed out with a red X next to a cylinder with a stop hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 超过检验有效期，就不能再用。

shots.section_title: 制造依据的标准和监管
shots.scene: 瓶肩另一侧的钢印特写，旁边一本空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: Another side of the cylinder shoulder with stamped marks, next to a blank standards book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 钢印还标明它按什么标准制造。
overlay: 制造依据的标准和监管

shots.section_title: 制造依据的标准和监管
shots.scene: 带空白合格铭牌的气瓶图标打绿勾，旁边一本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon with a blank certification plate and a green check mark, next to a blank regulations booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 国内使用的气瓶，要符合国内规定。

shots.scene: 钢瓶和铝瓶两个剖面图标
shots.prompt_en: Two cutaway icons: a steel cylinder and an aluminum cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 还有气瓶材质的标记，

shots.scene: 压力表图标，指针下方空白刻度
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon with a blank dial next to a cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 和公称工作压力，国内以兆帕计。

shots.scene: 钢印中一串编号被圈出，旁边身份证图标
shots.prompt_en: A stamped serial number on a cylinder shoulder circled in yellow, next to an ID card icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这串编号，是气瓶的身份证号。

shots.scene: 瓶肩上的空白条码贴纸和二维码贴纸
shots.prompt_en: A blank barcode sticker and a blank square code sticker on a cylinder shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 供应单位贴的条码，记着批号等信息。

shots.scene: 手机扫描气瓶上的二维码图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon scanning a square code sticker on a cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的能扫码，追溯气瓶来历。

shots.section_title: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的气瓶安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank gas cylinder safety handbook.
shots.narration: 细则查本校气瓶手册，不懂就问。
overlay: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 一排颜色各异、带色环的气瓶，旁边一本空白国标
shots.prompt_en: A row of cylinders of different colors with painted bands, beside a blank national standard booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 国内气瓶颜色有国家标准统一规定。

shots.scene: 气瓶上的瓶色、字样、色环三个部位被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Three parts of a cylinder circled: the body color, a blank lettering area and a colored band. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶色、字样、字色、色环，都有含义。

shots.scene: 淡蓝色氧气瓶和淡绿色氢气瓶，旁边空白标签打勾
shots.prompt_en: A light blue cylinder and a light green cylinder side by side, each with a blank label and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色帮你识别，但仍以字样标签为准。

shots.scene: 颜色剥落、字样模糊的气瓶被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with faded peeling paint and unreadable lettering, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色字样看不清，同样不能用。

shots.scene: 小研对着气瓶依次打勾三张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks three blank cards one by one beside a cylinder.
shots.narration: 接气瓶、用气瓶，先做三查。

shots.scene: 瓶帽、瓶阀、瓶身三个部位放大镜检查，锈蚀和凹陷处打叉
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass checks the cap, valve and body of a cylinder; spots of rust and a dent are marked with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶帽阀门完好，瓶身无锈蚀变形。

shots.scene: 老周从带资质牌的供气单位接收气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The older man receives a cylinder from a supplier counter that has a blank license plaque on the wall.
shots.narration: 气瓶要从有资质的单位购买或租用。

shots.scene: 来路不明的气瓶被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An unmarked cylinder left at a doorway with no label or tag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 来路不明的气瓶，不收不用。

shots.scene: 用油漆刷改颜色、用锉刀磨钢印的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a paint brush repainting a cylinder and a file grinding stamped marks, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁涂改钢印和颜色，严禁自行充装。

shots.scene: 小研在空白台账本上登记气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student records a cylinder in a blank logbook beside the cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 实验室要建气瓶台账。

shots.scene: 日历上提前标出提醒铃铛
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a bell reminder icon marked a few weeks before a circled date. No people.
shots.narration: 快到期提前联系，换瓶退瓶。

shots.section_title: 问题气瓶：停用、隔离、报告
shots.scene: 小研给超期气瓶挂上空白停用牌，移到角落
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs a blank out-of-service tag on a cylinder and moves it to a separate secured spot.
shots.narration: 超期、无标签、标记不清的气瓶，
overlay: 问题气瓶：停用、隔离、报告

shots.section_title: 问题气瓶：停用、隔离、报告
shots.scene: 隔离区里固定好的问题气瓶，旁边警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A separated area with a strapped cylinder and a general warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，单独固定存放。

shots.section_title: 问题气瓶：停用、隔离、报告
shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周打电话给供气单位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who then phones the gas supplier.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，联系供应单位收回。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现标签和象形图图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank label and a hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 认气体：看字样标签，查说明书。

shots.scene: 颜色图标旁一个小勾、一个提示符
shots.prompt_en: A colored cylinder icon with a small check mark and an info icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色是辅助，不能只凭颜色。

shots.scene: 日历加周期等于下次检验的图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar plus a cycle arrow equals a circled future date. No people.
shots.narration: 找最近检验日期，超期不用。

shots.scene: 台账本、停用牌和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank logbook, a blank out-of-service tag and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 建台账、问题瓶停用，报告处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜在气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass beside a strapped gas cylinder and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 看懂标记再用气，下次见！
